        - paragraph:
          - text: Extra earned vs. simple
          - strong: ₹ 693.28
        - heading "NOTICE THE PATTERN" [level=3]
        - paragraph: Interest each year is calculated on a larger base, so interest earned each period increases.
        - paragraph: The gap between compound and simple interest keeps widening.
        - heading "COMMON MISCONCEPTION" [level=3]
        - paragraph: Adding r% of the principal each year is simple interest, not compound interest.
        - paragraph: Compound interest earns on previous interest too.
      - article:
        - heading "UNDERSTAND THE RULE" [level=3]
        - paragraph: "Compound interest after t years with n compounding periods per year:"
        - strong:
          - text: A = P(1 + r/n)
          - superscript: nt
        - paragraph: Where P = principal, r = annual decimal rate, n = periods per year, and t = years.
      - article:
        - heading "WORKED EXAMPLE" [level=3]
        - paragraph: A sum of ₹20,000 is invested at 9% p.a., compounded quarterly, for 3 years.
        - paragraph:
          - text: A = 20000(1 + 0.09/4)
          - superscript: "12"
        - text: Amount after 3 years = ₹26,096.10
      - article:
